p10_b3.ocr: The focus on enhancing customer experience and offering tailored products appears to be resonating well with consumers, as evidenced by these positive trends. Moreover, a year-over-year analysis reveals that the Customer Growth Rate has been paramount to maintaining and increasing the company's Market Share. With a reported Customer Growth Rate of 15% in the previous period, this upward trajectory signifies not only retention of existing customers but also a successful acquisition of new ones. The strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing customer loyalty and satisfaction have likely contributed to these favorable outcomes.

p10_b4.ocr: Additionally, the revenue generated from GMV growth, notably amounting to $500M, underscores the financial health and operational effectiveness of Alibaba’s e-commerce platforms. As the company continues to innovate and refine its approach in a rapidly changing digital environment, these metrics will serve as critical indicators of future performance. Stakeholders and analysts alike will be keen to observe how these trends evolve and what new strategies Alibaba will deploy to maintain its competitive edge. The interplay between Average Order Value, Customer Growth Rate, and overall GMV is essential for understanding the company's positioning in the marketplace and its long-term viability in the North American region.
